notes.title: Discovr™ Egypt Version 1.1.0 Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We just released a small patch for Discovr Egypt. The larger optimization and content patch is still in the works, so keep an eye out for that in the near future.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the hand to a much nicer translucent white. (NO MORE ZOMBIE HAND!)
[*]Updated Treasure Hunt to have a clearer tutorial for viewing the checklist and timer.
[*]Placed checklist and timer on the back of the hand instead of the palm.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released
notes.content:
[b]Discovr™ Egypt Patch 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed installation of redistributables linked to some crashes
[*]Adjusted lighting and removed lens flare to make the gold less blinding (Sorry)
[*]Upgraded flashlight with a proper cookie texture so it looks better
[*]Fixed ability to quit the game using the Escape key at any time.
[/list]

Sorry for any problems that were caused by the crashes, and thanks to some of our users for helping us track down the root of the problem and repair it. You may need to validate your files if you are not receiving the patch, but it should update on its own.
